Read on for details! ／  There are two main components at work. The first is actually getting the flight data for the next flight out of PVD, and the second is generating this data as an image and pushing it to the device. Because these processes need to run continuously and I have a laptop, I bought a Raspberry Pi Zero for $12, installed Linux, and set up both of these tasks as cron jobs that run every few minutes. Similarly, because the Tidbyt can only pull data from web sources, I set up a cheap web server to host the data I pull. ／  I couldn't find an API that reliably listed the departures for the airport of my choice (PVD), so I ended up using Python to just perform some web scraping with BeautifulSoup of PVD's departure board on their website. Not the best method, particularly for generalizability's sake, but it's better than the alternative of unreliable data. However, their website does not display aircraft models, so after finding the next flight from the departure board, I query a different API to get the aircraft model for the flight. I then generate a map of the route from latitude and longitude, and push all this information to my web server.
